units.source_text: 一瞬间，确实意识到我被拒绝的时候，我便毫不犹豫，急忙转身跑下楼去。

en.t: In that instant, when I truly realized that I had been rejected, I did not hesitate at all, but hurriedly turned and ran downstairs.

units.source_text: 从浓烟的旋涡中一直下到了法水院，多半是从火里钻出来的。

en.t: Through the swirling thick smoke I went all the way down to Hosui-in, probably crawling out through the fire itself.

units.source_text: 好不容易来到西门，纵身跳到了户外。

en.t: At last I reached the west gate and threw myself outside.

units.source_text: 然后我就像韦驮天①那样拔腿就跑，连我自己也不知道要跑到什么地方去。

en.t: Then I took to my heels like Idaten himself, running without even knowing where I meant to go.
